questions.question: What is India’s rank in the International Intellectual Property Index 2019 brought out by the US Chamber of Commerce’s Global Innovation Policy Centre?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. **__36th.__**

__
 
• The **US Chamber of Commerce’s Global Innovation Policy Center** releases the **International Intellectual Property (IP)** **Index **every year. 
 
• The Index assesses the Intellectual Property regimes and developments in** 50 global economies. **
 
• **India’s progress on the Index list from rank 44th in 2018 to rank 36th this year is the highest among all the 50 participating nations mapped by the Index.**
 
• India’s overall score has increased substantially from 30.07% (12.03 out of 40) in the 6th edition to 36.04% (16.22 out of 45) in 2019.
 
• The top 5 economies are USA, UK, Sweden, France, and Germany.

**International Intellectual Property Index: **__

 
• International IP Index 2019 has been released by the U.S. Chamber of Commerce’s Global Innovation Policy Center (GIPC).
 
• This Index evaluates the IP infrastructure in each economy based on 45 unique indicators.
 
• The indicators encompass 8 categories of IP protection:

 
• Patents
 
• Copyrights
 
• Trademarks
 
• Trade secrets
 
• Commercialization of IP assets
 
• Enforcement
 
• Systemic efficiency, and membership
 
• Ratification of international treaties.

questions.question: Through which of the following countries does the Equator NOT pass?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. **__Thailand.__**

__
 
• The Equator passes through **13 countries**, **3 continents** and **3 water bodies.**
 
• **Countries through which Equator pass: Ecuador, Colombia, Brazil, Sao Tome & Principe, Gabon, Republic of the Congo, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, Kenya, Somalia, Maldives, Indonesia and Kiribati.**
 
• **Hence the Equator does not pass through Thailand.__**
 
• The equator passes through 3 continents: **Asia, Africa and South America**.
 
• The equator passes through 3 water bodies: **Atlantic Ocean, Pacific Ocean, Indian Ocean.**
 
• The **highest point** on the **equator** is located on the **Volcan Cayambe** southern slopes.

questions.question: Which of the following metals is used to make a protective coating to steel in the galvanisation process?
questions.solution:

**__Rusting of Iron:__**

• It can be prevented by painting, oiling, greasing, galvanising, chrome plating, anodising or making alloys.
 
• **​__Galvanisation: **It is defined as the process of applying a protective zinc coating to prevent rusting. 
 
• It forms a barrier that prevents corrosive substances from reaching the underlying steel or iron.
 
• The zinc protects its base metal by corroding before iron.

questions.question: In the context of LED what does D stand for?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. **__Diode.__**

 
• The full form of LED is **Light Emitting Diode.**

**LED:**

 
• It is an optical semiconductor device that emits light when voltage is applied means it converts electrical energy into light energy.
 
• Light Emitting Diode (LED) **works only in forward bias conditions.**
 
• When Light Emitting Diode (LED) is forward biased, the free electrons from the n-side and the holes from the p-side are pushed towards the junction.
 
• Light-emitting diodes **emit either visible light or invisible infrared light when forward biased.**
 
• The LEDs which emit invisible infrared light are used for remote controls.
 
• LEDs that can emit **red, yellow, orange, green and blue light** are available for commercial use.

questions.question: What does 'T' stand for in IVF-ET?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. **__Transfer.__**

 
• The full form of IVF-ET is** In Vitro Fertilization Embryo Transfer.**

 

**In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) **

 
• It is a series of procedures used to help with fertility or prevent genetic problems and assist with the conception of a child.
 
• During IVF, mature eggs are collected (retrieved) from ovaries and fertilized by sperm in a lab.
 
• Then the fertilized egg (embryo) or eggs (embryos) are transferred to a uterus.
 
• **One full cycle of IVF takes about three weeks.**

questions.question: Noble gases are ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1, i.e. **__monoatomic.__**

 
• Group 18 consists of six elements: **helium, neon, argon, krypton, xenon, and radon.**
 
• All these are gases and chemically unreactive.
 
• They form very few compounds.
 
• All the noble gases except radon occur in the atmosphere. 
 
• **All the noble gases are monoatomic. **
 
• They are colorless, odorless and tasteless. They are sparingly soluble in water. They have very low melting and boiling points. 
 
• The elements which are present in Group 18 have their orbitals completely filled. Hence, they don't react with other elements under normal conditions.

questions.question: Who among the following drafted the Indian Penal Code which later became the basis of the Indian Criminal Code?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. __**Thomas Babington Macaulay.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Thomas Babington Macaulay** inaugurated a national system of education and as president of a commission on Indian jurisprudence, he drafted a penal code that later became the basis of Indian Criminal Law. 
 
• The draft of the Indian Penal Code was prepared by the **first law commission in 1835** and has been submitted to the governor-general of the Indian Council in 1837.
 
• **Indian Penal Code** was **enacted in 1861.**

questions.question: Who was the first Indian sprinter to win a gold medal at the U-20 World Championships in a 400m event?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1, i.e. **__Hima Das.__**

 
• Sprinter Hima Das becomes the first Indian women athlete to win the gold in the women’s 400m final race in the **IAAF World Under-20 Athletics Championships **held in **Tampere, Finland, in 2018.**
 
• She recorded a** time of 51.46s** to win to clinch the top spot in this World Championship.
 
• No Indian woman or man before Hima Das has won a gold medal in a World Championship at any level, be it youth, junior or senior. 

**About IAAF:**

 
• **In July 1912 **after the closing ceremony of the Olympic games in Sweden, the** International Amateur Athletic Federation (IAAF)** was founded as the world governing body for the sport of track and field athletics.
 
• The IAAF’s name has changed, in 2001 to the ‘**International Association of Athletics Federations’ **and **then again in 2019 to 'World Athletics'.**
 
• The World Athletics headquarter is situated at **Monaco.**
